arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/threads.md'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('### Work that exists nowhere else')
j=s.index('### When there are no snapshots')
s=s[:i]+'''### Rewinds and forks

When the conversation is rewound or forked, pi-action restores the snapshot that was current at that point, not the newest one. pi-action never deletes a snapshot: the newer snapshots stay on the ref, and the message to pi names the newest one, so that pi can get its files back.

'''+s[j:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CONTRIBUTING.md'
s=open(p).read()
a='restores it at the start of a run, asking first when that would drop work |'
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,'restores it at the start of a run |')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run check >/tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo $?; grep -E "error|✗|×|FAIL|Unused|unused" /tmp/c.log | head
